I will be arriving in Paris on Sunday. Can you please provide me the the restaurant which serves French cuisine that open on Sunday? Recommend me the restaurant with the best rating and reviews.
            Tell me the restaurant name, rating, address, and the operating hours.

Restaurant in Paris: New Israeli Restaurant
Breizh Café
New Asiaway
Le Baratin
Bistrot Paul Bert
Royal Panda
The yard
China Garden
Miznon
Chez L'Ami Jean

```python
# Get all restaurants in Paris
paris_restaurants_raw = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

# Parse the list of restaurants using AI assistant
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import List

class RestaurantList(BaseModel):
    restaurants: List[str]

paris_restaurants = query_ai_assistant(
    f"Extract the list of restaurant names from the following text: {paris_restaurants_raw}",
    RestaurantList
).restaurants

# Get cuisine types for these restaurants
cuisine_types = get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants(paris_restaurants)

# Filter for French cuisine using AI assistant
class FrenchRestaurantFilter(BaseModel):
    french_restaurants: List[str]

french_restaurants = query_ai_assistant(
    f"From the following dictionary of restaurant names and their cuisine types, identify the restaurants that serve French cuisine. \n{cuisine_types}",
    FrenchRestaurantFilter
).french_restaurants

# Check opening hours for the French restaurants
opening_hours = check_restaurant_opening_hours(french_restaurants)

# Filter for restaurants open on Sunday using AI assistant
class SundayOpenFilter(BaseModel):
    open_on_sunday: List[str]

sunday_open_restaurants = query_ai_assistant(
    f"From the following dictionary of restaurant names and their opening hours, identify the restaurants that are open on Sunday. \n{opening_hours}",
    SundayOpenFilter
).open_on_sunday

# Get ratings and reviews for the Sunday open French restaurants
ratings_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(sunday_open_restaurants)

# Get the best rated restaurant using AI assistant
class BestRestaurant(BaseModel):
    name: str
    rating: str
    review: str

best_restaurant_info = query_ai_assistant(
    f"Based on the following ratings and reviews, identify the restaurant with the best rating and reviews. \n{ratings_reviews}",
    BestRestaurant
)

# Get address for the best restaurant
address_info = get_restaurants_address([best_restaurant_info.name])

# Get specific opening hours for the best restaurant to include in the final output
best_restaurant_hours = query_ai_assistant(
    f"Extract the opening hours for the following restaurant from the dictionary: \n{opening_hours}\nRestaurant Name: {best_restaurant_info.name}",
    str
)

# Construct the final response
result = {
    "name": best_restaurant_info.name,
    "rating": best_restaurant_info.rating,
    "address": address_info.get(best_restaurant_info.name, "Address not found"),
    "opening_hours": best_restaurant_hours
}

print(result)
```
